name: pay-per-prompt
description: Pay-per-prompt AI chat on Hedera. Every answer is settled with a native HTS HBAR payment through the x402 exact scheme, appended to a public HCS audit ledger, and the ledger topic is pinned by a deployed Solidity registry. The endpoint fails closed if the HCS append or the on-chain registry lookup fails, so the Hedera services are load-bearing, not decorative. Next.js + Hardhat monorepo.

envVars.description: Server-side operator account (0.0.x). Pays the HCS submit fee and deploys the registry.
ECDSA private key (hex) for the operator account. Never commit.
Mirror node REST base URL for the chosen network.
HCS topic (0.0.x) used as the public pay-per-prompt ledger.
Deployed LedgerRegistry contract id that pins the HCS topic on-chain.
Account each prompt payment settles to (x402 exact / HTS).
Fee-payer account id exposed by the x402 facilitator.
x402 facilitator base URL for testnet settlements.
Public demo signer account that authorizes the HBAR payment in the browser.
Public demo signer key (testnet only). Replace with a real wallet for production.
Client-side copy of PRICE_HBAR used by the UI.
API key for any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.
Model id, e.g. gpt-4o-mini (any OpenAI-compatible model).

steps.label: 1. Configure secrets
steps.text: Fill in the operator, receiver and demo client accounts. Fund the operator and client accounts with testnet HBAR from https://portal.hedera.com/faucet.

steps.label: 2. Create the HCS ledger topic + deploy the registry
steps.text: Idempotent: creates the 0.0.x topic and deploys LedgerRegistry, then prints HEDERA_TOPIC_ID and HEDERA_CONTRACT_ID to paste into .env.

steps.label: 3. Submit a sample HCS record
steps.text: Writes a test pay-per-prompt/ledger record to the topic so you can see it on HashScan.

steps.label: Verify the flow
steps.text: Ask a question. A real HTS payment settles through x402 and the prompt is appended to the HCS ledger — the UI shows a HashScan link for the payment and one for the ledger message.
